How a delivery is checked
You ordered 100 packets at ₹100. The truck brought 90. The system records the difference: 10 packets, about ₹1,000.
One person counts, a second person confirms. Cartons are converted to packets (1 carton = 20 packets) so nobody scans every packet.
The difference becomes a case with status New, Under Review, Explained or Closed, with the evidence attached. Nobody is blamed automatically.
